title: Najran_0Carbon: data and code for satellite evidence on low-carbon growth in Najran, Saudi Arabia
description: Earth Engine scripts, Python analysis code, blind validation points, zone-level indicators, land-cover and surface-temperature rasters (2000–2026) and a bilingual zone atlas supporting the article 'Guiding low-carbon growth in an arid oasis city: satellite evidence from Najran, Saudi Arabia'.
